title: Quickspell Gloves
summary: Toggle on to cast one Action-cost cantrip as a Bonus Action per Short Rest.

fields.Quickspell Flinger: Turn the passive on before casting. A cantrip that would cost an Action costs a Bonus Action instead. The toggle switches off after the cast resolves and the use recharges on a Short Rest.
fields.Acquisition: Buy from Lorroakan’s Projection or Rolan on the ground floor of Sorcerous Sundries at X −14, Y −72.
fields.Base value: 300 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 activation, trigger, recharge, and pricing with pinned source evidence.
